body:
Here are the most obvious reasons I can think of for our resident Nazi
(you know who he is) keeps flooding this group with so many posts under
so many different handles:

1.  He is a federal agent attempting to discredit the Unabomber by
    making sure that search engine results on the Unabomber turn
    up the archived Nazi propaganda he posts or vice-versa.

2.  He is also attempting to get past any filters we set up to
    screen him out.  By changing aliases so frequently his material
    gets by any filters we have set up and he can once again
    render the group unusable by Unabomber fans.  This would also
    be consistent with the actions of a federal agent.

3.  He is a federal agent or someone working for the Southern
    Poverty Law Center or similar group trolling for people with
    Nazi tendencies so as to expose and harass them publically.
    But that suggests a gross ignorance of the contents of the
    Manifesto.

What do you all think of my theories?  Which one seems most likely?

Dark Cloud

"Just think, an irresponsible genetic engineer might create a lot of
terrorists."
-- The Unabomber Manifesto
